editorialSummary.heading: Three nine-day breaks and a January quarter end
highlights: Fall, Thanksgiving and spring breaks each include both weekends
Students return January 4; the second quarter ends January 8
Presidents Day is a student holiday with a possible weather make-up change
paragraphs: DeSoto’s fall break begins Saturday, October 17, just after an early-release Friday, and continues through Sunday, October 25. Thanksgiving and spring breaks follow the same nine-day pattern, giving families a full week without classes between two weekends. The March break ends March 21. Students are scheduled to be back in class March 22-25 before the separate Good Friday holiday on March 26.

Christmas break falls within the second quarter. The named break is December 19-31, followed by New Year’s Day and a weekend. Students are scheduled to return January 4, and the quarter ends January 8 with early release. Two other quarter-end Fridays, October 16 and March 12, also have shortened schedules. September 16 and April 7 bring the year’s early-release total to five; check school notices for pickup times.

Keep February 15 flexible: Presidents Day is a student holiday and teacher workday, but it is also available for weather make-up. At the end of the year, classes finish Thursday, May 27. Graduation is listed for the following day, with ceremony details left to the school.

about.dataSource: The district’s School Calendar page links the same one-page 2026-2027 PDF supplied for this review. It lists open house, student holidays, early releases, quarter ends and graduation, along with 180 student days. No Board approval or publication date appears on the PDF.
about.processing: The local and current official PDFs have matching SHA-256 hashes. Both the extracted text and rendered page were reviewed. Fall break October 17-25, Thanksgiving November 21-29 and spring break March 13-21 explicitly include weekends. Christmas Break is retained as December 19-31; January 1 is a separate holiday, and the January 4 return is derived from that sequence and the following weekend. October 16 is one canonical early-release and quarter-end occurrence despite two source rows. January 8 and March 12 also retain both meanings; no additional semester-end or fourth-quarter endpoint event is inferred. February 15 is currently no classes with an explicit possible weather make-up path, so it is outside the confirmed closure list. The grid contains 209 weekdays from August 10 to May 27: 28 confirmed no-class weekdays and one conditional student holiday leave 180 scheduled attendance days, agreeing with the printed quarter and semester totals. The five early releases remain attendance days. August 6 open house and May 28 graduation are family-relevant events outside regular class dates; staff onboarding, July/August planning and July 3/May 31 holidays outside the student year are omitted. The May 28 records day is not duplicated as a staff event. Monthly-calendar time slots are event entries, not verified student dismissal times.

faqs.question: When does school start and end in DeSoto County for 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: Students start Monday, August 10, 2026 and finish Thursday, May 27, 2027. The calendar does not mark the last day for early release. Open house takes place the week before school begins.

faqs.question: When is open house?
faqs.answer: Open house is Thursday, August 6, 2026. The district calendar gives the date but no time. Check your school’s announcement for visiting hours and any classroom or teacher assignments.

faqs.question: When is fall break, and when do students return?
faqs.answer: Fall break runs Saturday, October 17 through Sunday, October 25, 2026, including both weekends. Students are scheduled to return Monday, October 26. Friday, October 16 is an early-release school day before the break.

faqs.question: What are the Thanksgiving break dates?
faqs.answer: Thanksgiving break is November 21-29, 2026. That gives students nine consecutive days off, including the weekends. The five weekdays without classes are November 23-27, with a scheduled return Monday, November 30.

faqs.question: When is Christmas break, and when does school resume in January?
faqs.answer: The calendar lists Christmas break as December 19-31, 2026, followed by the New Year’s Day holiday on January 1, 2027. With the January 2-3 weekend, students have 16 consecutive days off. Classes are scheduled to resume Monday, January 4.

faqs.question: When is spring break in 2027?
faqs.answer: Spring break runs Saturday, March 13 through Sunday, March 21, 2027. Students are scheduled to return Monday, March 22. The Friday before the break, March 12, is an early-release school day and the last day of the third quarter.

faqs.question: Is Good Friday part of spring break?
faqs.answer: Good Friday, March 26, 2027, is a separate no-school holiday. Students are scheduled to attend March 22-25 after spring break, then return Monday, March 29 after the three-day Easter weekend.

faqs.question: Which days have early release?
faqs.answer: The five early-release dates are September 16 and October 16, 2026, and January 8, March 12 and April 7, 2027. Students attend school on each date. October 16, January 8 and March 12 also end a grading quarter.

faqs.question: What time do students leave on early-release days?
faqs.answer: The annual calendar does not give dismissal times for its five early-release dates. Check your school’s pickup and bus notices for the time that applies to your child before arranging transportation or after-school care.

faqs.question: Is there school on Presidents Day?
faqs.answer: Students are scheduled to be off Monday, February 15, 2027, while teachers have a workday. The same date is reserved as a potential inclement weather make-up day, so it could become a student attendance day if the district announces a change.

faqs.question: Are Labor Day and Martin Luther King Jr. Day student holidays?
faqs.answer: Yes. There are no classes on Monday, September 7, 2026 for Labor Day or Monday, January 18, 2027 for Martin Luther King Jr. Day. Students are scheduled to return the following Tuesday after each holiday.

faqs.question: When do the grading quarters end?
faqs.answer: The first three quarters end October 16, 2026, January 8, 2027 and March 12, 2027. All three dates have early release. The second quarter continues after Christmas break, with students scheduled to return January 4. The school year ends May 27; the calendar does not separately label a fourth-quarter end date.

faqs.question: How many student days are in the school year?
faqs.answer: The PDF lists 180 student days: 89 in the first semester and 91 in the second. Its quarter totals are 49, 40, 43 and 48 days. February 15 is currently a student holiday but could be used for weather make-up.

faqs.question: When is graduation, and do students have classes that day?
faqs.answer: The district calendar lists graduation on Friday, May 28, 2027, a records day with no school. Classes end the day before, May 27. The PDF does not give a ceremony time or location; confirm those details with your school.

faqs.question: Is Veterans Day a school holiday on this calendar?
faqs.answer: The 2026-2027 district calendar does not list a student holiday or early release on Wednesday, November 11, 2026. Families should plan for a regular school day unless the district or their school announces a change.

faqs.question: Where can I download the official calendar and check for changes?
faqs.answer: The district’s School Calendar page links the printable 2026-2027 PDF. For changes during the school year, check district announcements and messages from your child’s school, especially if February 15 is being considered for weather make-up.
